name: autoform
description: Set up Lean repositories, build source-grounded Markdown roadmaps, and support human or agent review.

interface.shortDescription: Lean setup, roadmaps, review, LSP, and REPL
interface.longDescription: AutoForm separates repository setup from source-grounded roadmap construction, keeps the plan in an Obsidian-compatible Markdown vault, publishes it with GitHub Pages, checks proofs through two public Lean MCP servers, and provides visual, rubric-driven, and refreshable declaration-review workflows.
defaultPrompt: Set up this Lean repository with an Autoform vault, verification CI, and GitHub Pages without planning the mathematics.
Build or refine an Autoform roadmap from my mathematical sources.
Prepare the visual blueprint surfaces so I can review this formalization.
Judge this roadmap or Lean formalization with evidence-based review rubrics.
Refresh the minimal source-to-Lean declaration checklist for the current snapshot.
Develop Autoform itself through its executable formalization example.
